text:
Maya Lin: quick sync on the token-ingest postmortem actions. want owners and an exact runbook for credits + ledger patches. aiming to close remediation this sprint.
Omar Wallace: missing tokens traced to downstream dequeue delay between 2024-04-02 03:00 and 03:45 UTC. plan: (A) deterministic backfill, (B) canonical reconcile file, (C) invoice adjustments + customer comms, (D) follow-up monitors. i can own A and D.
Jun Park: i'll own B and the ledger patch mapping. need backfill job_id and provenance fields so CSV is auditable. include original_event_id, source_bucket, processing_stage.
Hannah Li: i'll draft the customer-facing note and the internal finance memo. for customers: short explanation + credit amount + how it appears on next invoice. internal memo needs cost impact and rollback plan. need final credit counts by 16:00 PST.
billing-bot: remediation ticket RED-2024-099 opened. owners: Omar (backfill+monitoring), Jun (reconcile+ledger), Hannah (comms), Maya (program owner). target_close: 2599993600. status: triaged.
Omar Wallace: backfill plan: pilot on 5k accounts 22:00 UTC tonight. full-job params: job=backfill-2024-04-dequeue start=2024-04-02T03:00Z end=2024-04-02T03:45Z workers=8 consistency=strong. pilot validates idempotency and dedupe keys; full run est ~3.5h.
Jun Park: CSV schema requested: account_id, invoice_id, token_delta, original_event_ts, backfill_job_id, original_event_id, commit_flag, overlapping_invoice_window, audit_hash, action_suggested. action_suggested values: auto_credit, manual_review, ignore.
Hannah Li: crediting policy draft: auto_credit if token_delta >= 500 OR token_delta >= 5% of monthly usage; manual_review for 50-499; ignore under 50. exceptions: committed_units=true accounts need review.
Maya Lin: add rule: if overlapping_invoice_window=true and token_delta > 0 then manual_review regardless of size. avoids double adjustments.
Jun Park: will flag commit_flag and overlapping_invoice_window. will also include cost_estimate column for finance.
Omar Wallace: ops note: can tag events with customer_billing_tier at ingest; will surface commit_flag via billing join.
ops-oncall-bot: backfill may increase ledger DB write RPS. recommend maintenance window 02:00-05:00 UTC.
Maya Lin: schedule pilot 22:00 UTC, full run 02:00 UTC tomorrow if pilot green. Jun, Hannah, can you have artifacts within 6h of full run completion?
Jun Park: yes 94 reconciliation CSV and audit manifest within 4h of completion.
Hannah Li: can do comms draft within 4h. finance sign-off after Jun posts costs.
billing-bot: RED-2024-099 updated: pilot_scheduled=2599987200, full_run_est=2599993200, postrun_deadline=2599996800. link: https://redwood.internal/remediations/RED-2024-099
Omar Wallace: QA checklist post-backfill: (1) total token delta equals expected requeued volume, (2) samples show idempotency, (3) no invoice duplication. will post logs and sample accounts here.
Jun Park: i'll run diff tool: diff_tool --left=pre_ingest_ledger --right=post_backfill_ledger --out=rediff-RED-2024-099.csv and include per-invoice hashes.
Hannah Li: communications plan: phase 1 auto-email for auto_credit recipients, phase 2 CS outreach for manual_review accounts; include appeal link.
Maya Lin: escalation: if cost delta > $50k pause auto-credit and route to finance execs. Sachin will be looped if hits threshold.
Jun Park: noted; including cost_estimate column speeds finance review.
Maya Lin: final ask: post short status updates here as you complete milestones. i'll run a 17:00 sync if anything slips. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
